jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health. Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar. Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale. About the role As a Product Manager at Scarlet, you will own a meaningful product area end to end. You will develop a deep understanding of the people and problems within it, set a clear direction, decide what matters most, and work with product design and engineering to deliver measurable improvements. You will sit close to regulatory experts, account managers and customers in our London office. Their expertise will give you rich signals, but not a ready-made roadmap. Your job is to turn those signals into a coherent product strategy, make trade-offs openly and ensure what we build improves both the quality and speed of certification. You will have substantial autonomy. We will trust you to form a point of view, test it against evidence and change course when the evidence changes. Responsibilities Own the strategy, roadmap and outcomes for a product area, from discovery and definition through launch, adoption and iteration. Partner closely with product design, engineering and regulatory experts to turn complex requirements into clear, trustworthy workflows. Spend time with customers and internal users to understand their work, observe friction and distinguish underlying problems from requested features. jobs.title: Clinical Research associate II
jobs.description: Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. What sets us apart is the way we integrate clinical trial execution with deep scientific knowledge, laboratory expertise and advanced data sciences. We have a strong focus on Oncology and Rare Disease. We are passionate about cultivating our culture and are proud to share extremely high CRA retention rates compared to industry averages. CRAs join us, love their jobs, and stay because of the amazing people and enjoyable quality of life. You will have a lower than average number of protocols, setting you up to be a protocol expert. Travel is reasonable and your work/life balance will benefit as a result. Most meaningfully - your voice will be heard. Working in a smaller CRO allows you to have influence and impact when it matters most and support from direct line management. We are now recruiting Clinical Research Associate II to join our team in Belgium or the Netherlands. This is a remote based position with travel to sites for morning visits. We are looking for candidates based in Belgium or the Netherlands with oncology monitoring experience. About you: You are calm, thoughtful, and responsive when things don’t go as planned. You are well-prepared, whether it be for an investigator meeting, site visit or project team update, always staying two steps ahead of the game. You find quick and creative ways of overcoming difficulties. You have an impeccable eye for detail. You identify potential study risks and propose solutions on how to mitigate them. You take responsibility in the quality and outcomes of your work. You are adept at handling conflict by using tried and true resolution strategies. jobs.title: Psychosociaal Therapeut
jobs.description: BetterHelp – Word onderdeel van het grootste online therapieplatform ter wereld! Bij BetterHelp hebben we als missie om barrières voor therapie weg te nemen en geestelijke gezondheidszorg voor iedereen toegankelijk te maken. Sinds onze oprichting in 2013 zijn we uitgegroeid tot de grootste online therapie dienst ter wereld, met betaalbare en toegankelijke therapie in meer dan 210 landen. Ter voorbereiding op onze EU-lancering in Nederland zoeken wij gekwalificeerde counselors en therapeuten om ons netwerk te versterken. Sluit u aan bij het grootste online counseling platform ter wereld! Voordelen van werken bij BetterHelp: Werk met een eersteklas organisatie tijdens onze uitbreiding in Europa. Alles-in-één platform: Voer uw sessies soepel uit zonder u zorgen te maken over klantwerving, facturatie of administratieve taken—wij nemen dat allemaal voor onze rekening! Flexibiliteit: Geef therapiesessies vanaf elke locatie, ondersteund door een toonaangevend wereldwijd platform. Gespecialiseerde cliëntgroepen: Richt u op de gebieden waar u het meest gepassioneerd over bent. Geen overheadkosten: Er worden nooit kosten in rekening gebracht bij de counselor. Autonomie over klinische beslissingen: U bent de gekwalificeerde en ervaren counselor. BetterHelp respecteert uw klinische oordeel en expertise om de meest effectieve en geschikte aanpak voor elke cliënt te bepalen. Ondersteuning en hulpmiddelen: Counselors op het BetterHelp-platform ontvangen gratis toegang tot een BetterHelp-account – zodat u ook tijd kunt besteden aan uw eigen welzijn! Concurrerende vergoeding en bonussen: Verdien €500 wanneer u uw eerste cliënt binnen 14 dagen na aanmelding accepteert. (Eerste-cliëntbonussen kunnen wijzigen, dus dit is het perfecte moment om u aan te sluiten!) Voor wie is dit van toepassing: Counselors die flexibiliteit zoeken om teletherapie vanaf elke locatie te geven. Counselors die zich willen richten op klinisch werk—wij nemen de werving van cliënten, facturatie en ondersteuning

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner Clinical Registries
jobs.description: Our mission We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients’ and clinicians’ experience. Our mission We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients' and clinicians' experience. Your impact Dutch clinical registries are among the richest sources of outcome data in Europe. At LOGEX, that data reaches clinicians and hospitals through applications such as Codman and Data Entry, and reaches researchers and healthcare professionals through data requests and exports. As Senior Product Owner you own that portfolio end to end: the applications that clinicians use every day, and the data pipelines that power them. You are the product owner for our largest registry partner and decide what gets built within a fixed capacity. You also make sure that what we build strengthens the wider LOGEX platform wherever possible. What you'll own Applications: user-facing applications for manual data entry, dashboarding and exports – owning the roadmap, priorities and release quality. Pipelines and business logic: registry processing (merge, load, curation), data exports, scientific data requests, data linkage and registry development sets. One backlog, two types of developers: you lead the product work of a team that combines data engineers with back-end and front-end developers. You translate user and partner’s needs into work for both, and you see early where a front-end change depends on a pipeline change. Prioritisation within fixed capacity: you align with one counterpart at our largest registry partner on what gets built and when, with transparent trade-offs, realistic yearly planning and a clear path to extra capacity when it is funded. Reusable by design: you turn partner-specific needs into shared LOGEX components wherever possible, in close collaboration with other Product Owners and Product Managers. Regulatory and

jobs.title: Union Relations Lead / Directeur(rice) du Paritarisme
jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The mission of the Union Relations Lead Unions and social partners play a central and legitimate role in how social protection is designed, negotiated and implemented in France. jobs.title: Roving Clinic Nurse
jobs.description: About the role Remedy Skintech, Inc. is seeking an experienced Roving Clinic Nurse to join our dynamic team in Metro Manila. As a Roving Clinic Nurse, you will play a crucial role in providing high-quality nursing care and support to our patients in an aesthetic clinic setting. What you'll be doing Deliver high-quality laser procedures to our patients Assist on doctors' procedures In charge of post-op procedures like equipment maintenance patients' post-treatment protocols Undergo training for all Remedy treatments Collaborating with the team to coordinate patient care and facilitate a smooth patient experience Providing patient education and promoting healthy behaviours to support positive health outcomes Maintaining a clean, safe, and well-organised clinical environment What we offer At Remedy Skintech, Inc., we value our employees and strive to create a supportive, collaborative work environment. As a Roving Clinic Nurse, you can expect competitive salary, and opportunities for professional development and career advancement. About us Remedy Skintech, Inc. is a leading provider of advanced dermatological services and skincare products in the Philippines. Our mission is to empower individuals to achieve their healthiest, most radiant skin through innovative treatments and personalized care. With a team of experienced medical professionals and a state-of-the-art facility, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional patient outcomes and an unparalleled customer experience. If you're passionate about nursing and committed to making a difference in the lives of our patients, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
